markdown-it-texmath 1.0.0, MIT, https://github.com/goessner/markdown-it-texmath
Source: npm markdown-it-texmath@1.0.0. Adaptations: appended ESM default export; normalized line endings and trailing whitespace.
Vendored for offline use. Rendering is overridden by the application to retain its
safe KaTeX options and blue highlighting. No runtime CDN or npm install required.
